desc:
Bear County, Fairview is a realistic open world roleplay game on Console & PC with 1.8M+ visits! Patrol as State Patrol, Sheriff, City PD or Game Warden, fight fires and save lives with Fire & EMS, or live the civilian life.

🚗 Buy and own your dream car at the dealership, customize it, hitch up a trailer, launch your boat at the lake or drive for Bear County Taxi.

📻 Real roleplay systems you won't find anywhere else: our own FD ELS emergency lights, a live radio with a voice dispatcher, crash damage, car fires and a full medical system.

Last Update Changelogs:
🤖 NEW AI 911 Calls for Police!
🚑 NEW AI EMS when no medics are on!
⭐ NEW XP System for Police, Fire & Civ!
👮 NEW Armory, MDT Records & Officer Hints!
❄️ Snow Storms are here!
🛡️ Big Anti-Cheat Upgrade + Bug Fixes!

👍 Help us reach 4,000 likes for a new code!

⚠️ Running into problems? Message us in our community server (Social Links below) and we'll do our best to help.
